violated_contract: A quota display and the operation it describes must use the same data plane and provider-specific entitlement. Treating any enrolled LLM key as unlimited while the operation only consumes one provider's key lets the meter promise access that the send gate correctly refuses.
canonical_prevention: Share the operation's required-provider capability between quota reporting and enforcement, use the same customer store, and compare the real paths below and at the cap with provider, enrollment and request-validation variants. Keep settings copy scoped to the capabilities those keys actually fund.
